title: Toggle refinement not working after facetFilters initialization
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
Initial search filters

```js
  searchParameters: {
    page: 0,
    hitsPerPage: 100,
    disjunctiveFacetsRefinements: {
      is_popular: [true, 'true'],
      is_full: [false, 'false']
    },
....
```

The above works as expected. Hits are filtered correctly.

However, following this clicking on one of the prefiltered toggles e.g. `is_full` does not filter the search.

Here is an example toggle filter setup

```js
search.addWidget(
  instantsearch.widgets.toggle({
    container: '#refinement-list4',
    attributeName: 'is_popular',
    label: 'Is Popular',
    values: {
      on: true
    },
    templates: {}
  })
)
```

Note if I remove initial filtering from the config the toggles work as expected.

Here is a live demo:
http://sfhotevents.ml/

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

* Initial filters applied on first page load
* Toggles should work e.g. clicking `Is not full` see http://sfhotevents.ml/

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
all, all

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**
not sure

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
Have an initial facet refinement which can be removed by the user via toggles
http://sfhotevents.ml/

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**
not sure

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.js@2.3/dist/instantsearch.min.js
